==Biography==
===2015 Season===
Tanner "'''Damonte'''" Damonte began playing ''League of Legends'' competitively in early 2015, with the nicknames '''Mini''' and '''Mini Me'''. In January, he played with [[Infinity Esports (2015 North American Team)|Infinity Esports]] in the [[2015 NA Challenger Series/Spring Qualifier|NACS Spring Qualifier]], but was eliminated in round 1 by [[Team Liquid Academy]]. Throughout the course of the year, he played on multiple other teams, including [[Cerberus eSports]] and [[Noble eSports]], with whom he participated in the [[AlphaDraft Challenger League]]. 

===2016 Season===
In October 2015, Damonte joined [[Serpentis eSports]]. The team played in the [[HTC Ascension]] Cup but later disbanded after an unsuccessful [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Spring Qualifiers/Open Qualifier|NACS Spring Qualifier]] run in January 2016. Damonte then joined [[the monkeys]] (which would later rename to [[Destined For Glory]]) for the [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Summer Qualifiers/Open Qualifier|Summer Open Qualifier]]. This time, his team made the [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Summer Qualifiers|Main Qualifier]] but fell to [[Cloud9 Challenger]]. In June, Damonte joined [[Nova eSports (North American Team)|Nova eSports]], a new team that had purchased [[Ember]]'s [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Summer Season|NACS Summer Season]] seed.

== Trivia ==
* At the same time as making Challenger the first time, he was also playing baseball and American football at his high school.
* Became known for his {{ci|Qiyana}} after being the first LCS player to play and win with it after its release.
* Known for his catchphrase, "Tanner Time."
* One of his coaches in amateur once trolled Leaguepedia staff by telling them he was born in Luxembourg.
